summary: Backend-only verification of two changes: (1) PaymentCreate no longer requires invoice_id in body; (2) Invoice model has monthly_fee (default 5.0) added to total. Added 7 new tests in TestMonthlyFeeAndPayment. Full pytest suite: 25/25 PASSED in 4.01s. Verified: POST /api/invoices/{id}/payment succeeds with {amount} only and with {amount, notes} (no invoice_id); invoice created with consumption_charge=85 + monthly_fee=5 -> total=90 -> remaining=90; partial (pay 30 -> remaining 60, status=partial) and full (pay 90 -> remaining 0, status=paid) transitions work; cumulative payments (30+60) close invoice; 404 on non-existent invoice. All existing endpoints (auth, customers, generators, expenses, reports/debts, reports/financial, reports/consumption, readings, dashboard) remain green. No regressions.

minor.issue: total_amount is still client-supplied. Server should compute total = consumption_charge + monthly_fee + previous_balance to prevent client mismatch. Currently trusts the client value.
No validation that amount > 0. A payment with amount=0 or negative is silently accepted.
No guard against overpayment (amount > remaining). remaining_amount can go negative, though status still becomes 'paid'.

action_items: Main agent may self-verify the fixes are live by opening the mobile app -> invoice detail -> record payment (تسجيل دفعه). It should now succeed.
Optional hardening: compute total_amount server-side; reject amount<=0 in PaymentCreate; clamp/refuse overpayment.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses Pydantic v1 .dict() and deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to .model_dump() and lifespan handlers.
Admin credentials (MS / Ms28796610**) hardcoded in server.py - move to env vars.
server.py is 683 lines; consider splitting routers per resource.
add_payment endpoint has no upper-bound validation on payment amount (can overpay to negative remaining).
seed_data_creation: All new tests create TEST_ prefixed customers/readings/invoices and clean up via DELETE /api/customers/{id} in try/finally blocks. No permanent data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both requested changes are verified working: (1) PaymentCreate model in server.py L143-146 has only {amount, payment_date, notes} — no invoice_id — and add_payment endpoint (L400) extracts invoice_id from URL path. (2) Invoice/InvoiceCreate now include monthly_fee: float = 5.0 (L103, L115). Total_amount is still client-supplied; frontend must compute total = consumption_charge + monthly_fee. Baseline: 25/25 pytest green. Known minor: total_amount not server-computed, no amount>0 or overpayment guards on payment endpoint.
